dataClass.name: finding-evidence
dataClass.meaning: Potentially sensitive application/repository finding metadata, source locations and bounded untrusted evidence/code excerpts; not certified public/redacted; credentials/configuration keys are excluded from approved payload content.

policy.localOnly: only family local, even if hosted family endpoint is loopback; no GrantID
policy.approvedHosted: real persisted grant looked up by ID, current profile/policy revision, exact destination, selected workspace/task/class, expiry/revocation; applies to all families

grantIssuerDecision: Issuing/revoking actor must be admin at that transaction. Grant is a durable workspace decision; later issuer role demotion alone does not infer revocation. Current requesting actor membership is checked at each Resolve. Withdrawal is explicit revoke, expiry or profile/policy revision invalidation.
profileRevisions: Server-assigned nonempty strings map directly to providers.Profile.Revision. Public no-op retains revision; meaningful changes and explicit nonempty key replacement advance it.
validationGap: providers.Open constructs a no-I/O snapshot but per-profile checks currently live in Assess. Setup needs pure validation reuse/factoring, never calling Assess as validation. Existing TLS/proxy/client constraints are not relaxed.
historicalUpgradeBaseline: Exact published v1-v6 DDL, no current-table deletion/version relabel and no old customer-data preservation claim.
